categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three business segments: Military Equipment, 5G RF (Radio Frequency) Electronics, and New Generation Integrated Electronic Information (Tianrong Project). The Military Equipment segment focuses on low-altitude defense systems, including portable air defense missile command systems and integrated radar and command systems. The 5G RF segment covers RF materials, devices, chips, and semiconductor packaging, serving both civilian and military markets. The Tianrong Project encompasses integrated electronic information systems with applications in low-altitude economy, emergency equipment, digital health, big data, and digital ocean technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced radar systems, intelligent detection, data fusion, underwater acoustic detection, unmanned underwater platforms, system integration, and command system manufacturing. The company leverages microwave ferrite materials, RF devices, RF chips, and advanced semiconductor packaging materials. Manufacturing methods adhere to strict military standards for defense products and employ order-based production for civilian products. The company also emphasizes R&D in AI, big data analytics, 5G communications, and integrated sensing technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include domestic military branches (Army, Navy, Air Force, Rocket Force), international defense clients, major global communication equipment manufacturers, and government agencies. The company serves markets in defense electronics, 5G wireless infrastructure, low-altitude airspace management, emergency response, digital health, and maritime surveillance. It also targets emerging sectors like low-altitude economy, smart cities, and digital ocean monitoring.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with key facilities in Xi'an, Beijing, Shenzhen, Nanjing, Chengdu, Hainan, and other regions. It serves domestic military and civilian markets and has expanded its presence internationally through participation in global defense exhibitions and overseas sales. Approximately 78% of revenue is from domestic markets, with the remainder from international customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures core materials (e.g., ferrite materials), components (RF devices and chips), and complete systems (military defense systems, integrated electronic information solutions). It also provides system integration, technical services, and customized solutions, positioning itself as a key supplier to both military and civilian end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic focus includes advancing low-altitude defense capabilities, expanding 5G RF technology applications in military and civilian sectors, and developing integrated electronic information systems under the Tianrong Project. R&D priorities cover radar technology, AI-driven data analytics, digital health, emergency response systems, and digital ocean technologies. The company emphasizes innovation in military-civil fusion, digital transformation, and building a comprehensive sensing and data service ecosystem.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of military equipment, RF materials, devices, chips, and integrated electronic systems. The company also earns income from technical transfers, joint production agreements, maintenance services, and data service solutions. Sales are predominantly direct to military clients, communication equipment manufacturers, and government agencies, with some leasing income from equipment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a competitive position in specialized military defense electronics and 5G RF components, with recognized technology advantages and certifications. It competes with domestic and international firms in military electronics, RF materials, and semiconductor packaging. The company leverages its integrated product lines and strategic partnerships to maintain and expand market share, particularly in low-altitude defense and 5G military applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 402 million, a 14.74% increase from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 105 million, showing a reduction in losses compared to prior years. Total assets were around RMB 2.46 billion, with a slight decrease from the previous year. The company is in a growth phase with ongoing investments in R&D and infrastructure, including a major 5G communications industrial park project.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated low-altitude defense systems combining radar, command, and missile technologies tailored for modern battlefield needs. Its RF materials and devices offer high performance across a broad frequency range, supporting both civilian 5G infrastructure and military applications. The Tianrong Project provides a unique 'air-ground-water-space-human' integrated sensing and data platform, enabling comprehensive situational awareness and digital transformation for defense and civilian sectors. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, military certifications, and strategic industry collaborations differentiate it in the market.
